description: Implement `schedule_autostart`: read the user crontab via `popen("crontab -l", "r")`; if no line already contains both `@reboot` and `binary_path`, append the line formatted with `CRON_ENTRY_TEMPLATE` (from `config.h`, a printf format taking one string argument) and `binary_path`, then install the updated crontab via `popen("crontab -", "w")`. Return 0 on success and -1 on failure.
